openapi.title: Crewhall REST API
openapi.description:
HTTP access to the organization's Crewhall workspace. Every endpoint is generated from the contract table; the schemas are the zod schemas the server validates with.

**Authentication:** send a personal token created under My account › MCP and API in the `Authorization: Bearer mhp_…` header. A token acts with its owner's permissions, limited to the scopes and spaces you picked; account, security and vault endpoints are never open to tokens.

**Errors** come back as `{ code, message, details? }`. **Pagination** uses cursors: send `cursor` and `limit`, the response is `{ items, nextCursor }`. Writing endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header.
openapi.tokenScope: With a personal token, needs the `{scope}` scope.
openapi.noToken: Session only; not available with personal tokens.
openapi.idempotency: A repeated request with the same key returns the first response (24 hours).
openapi.personalToken: Personal access token (starts with `mhp_`); accepted only where the description names a scope.
openapi.sessionToken: The mobile app's session token (better-auth bearer).
